actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The dragon exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Antimagic Cone
traits.description: The beholder's central eye creates an area of antimagic, as in the antimagic field spell, in a 150-foot cone. At the start of each of its turns, the beholder decides which way the cone faces.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.description: The beholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within 120 feet: Charm Ray, Paralyzing Ray, Fear Ray, Slowing Ray, Enervation Ray, Telekinetic Ray, Sleep Ray, Petrification Ray, Disintegration Ray, Death Ray.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

legendaryActions.description: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6+10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The tarrasque has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reflective Carapace
traits.description: Any time the tarrasque is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target.

actions.name: Tail

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The tarrasque makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.description: The tarrasque makes one claw attack or tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The tarrasque moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The tarrasque makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.
